title: GhostVue component manifest
description: Machine-readable public contract for one GhostVue component. Docs, the future @ghostvue/mcp server, codegen, and evals all read this shape. Instance documents set schemaVersion; breaking schema changes bump the $id major version.

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this manifest document's schema. Start at 1.0.0. Bump when the instance shape this file uses changes; a major bump also requires a new $id URL.

source.description: How this file was produced. generated files are written by pnpm manifests:write from the Ghost*.vue source; handwritten is allowed only when no matching SFC exists yet. Machine-derived API fields are overwritten on regeneration; descriptions, status, styling, accessibility, and examples are preserved.

name.description: Public Vue component export name. Must use the Ghost prefix from ADR 0003 (GhostButton, GhostDialog).

package.description: npm package that exports this component. Headless unstyled components live in @ghostvue/vue; themed wrappers live in @ghostvue/themes.

status.description: Stability of the public contract. experimental is the pre-release default; deprecated remains available with a documented replacement.

description.description: One-paragraph summary of what the component is for, enough for an agent to decide whether to use it.

props.description: Declared component props. Native HTML and ARIA fallthrough is not listed; only props the component owns.

models.description: v-model bindings. Each entry is a prop plus its update:* emit, using the names in docs/architecture/component-state.md.

events.description: Component-emitted events and payload types. Native listeners that fall through to a native root are omitted.

slots.description: Public slots and the props each slot receives. default is the primary content slot; named slots are semantic structure, not CSS hooks.

exposed.description: Template-ref surface: methods and properties returned by defineExpose.

styling.description: Stable styling hooks. Changing these is a breaking public API change, same as renaming a prop.

parts.description: data-part values that name structure (root, icon, indicator). Not Vue slots invented only to target CSS.

states.description: data-state values that name state (loading, open, disabled) when a native attribute is not already sufficient.

cssProperties.description: Public CSS custom properties consumers may set. Must use the --ghost- prefix from ADR 0007. Private --_ghost-* properties are unpublished and must not appear here.

accessibility.description: Accessibility contract an agent can implement without reading the human spec.

role.description: ARIA role of the primary widget, or the native implicit role when no ARIA role is set (for example button on a native <button>).

apgPattern.description: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices pattern URL this widget follows.

keyboard.description: Map of keyboard key names to the action they perform. Keys use event.key values (Enter, Escape, ArrowDown). Native-only widgets still list the keys the contract depends on.

additionalProperties.description: Action performed when this key is pressed in the relevant state.

requiredAriaAttributes.description: ARIA attributes the component always sets, or that consumers must supply for a valid instance (for example aria-label on icon-only buttons). Native disabled is not listed here.

examples.description: Stable example identifiers matching unpublished files at examples/<id>.vue. Prefer the path form (button/icon-only). Kebab-case ids remain valid. Not filesystem paths from the repository root.

items.description: Example id: component/name (button/icon-only) or a legacy kebab-case token.

name.description: CamelCase prop name. Boolean props omit is/has (disabled, loading, open).

type.description: TypeScript type as a string, for example boolean or 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'.

default.description: Literal default used when the consumer omits the prop. Omit this field when the prop is required or has no default.

anyOf.description: String default, including string-literal unions such as button.
Null default, used when null is a real controlled value rather than unset.

required.description: True when the consumer must pass the prop. False when it has a default or may be omitted.

description.description: What the prop controls, including interaction with other props.

deprecated.description: True when the prop is still accepted but should not be used in new code.

model.description: One v-model binding: the readable prop and the update event that writes it.

prop.description: Prop that holds the current value (modelValue, open, pressed).

event.description: Emit that writes the value. Must be update:<prop> (update:modelValue, update:open, update:pressed).

type.description: TypeScript type of the bound value.

description.description: Controlled versus uncontrolled behavior, including the matching default* prop when one exists.

name.description: Emit name. Semantic verbs (select, close) except for update:* v-model events, which belong in models.

payloadType.description: TypeScript type of the emit payload. Use void when the event carries no payload.

description.description: When the event fires and whether it is cancelable.

slotProp.description: One prop passed into a slot.

name.description: Slot prop name as received by the slot function.

type.description: TypeScript type of the slot prop.

description.description: What the slot prop is for.

name.description: Slot name. default is the primary content slot; other names are camelCase semantic structure (icon, title).

props.description: Props passed to this slot. Empty when the slot receives no scoped props.

description.description: What content belongs in the slot.

kind.description: Whether the member is a method or a readable property.

type.description: TypeScript type or call signature, for example HTMLButtonElement | null or (options?: FocusOptions) => void.

description.description: What the member does, including no-op behavior before mount.

namedHook.description: A documented data-part or data-state value.

name.description: Hook token written to the attribute (root, loading).

description.description: What this part or state represents.

name.description: Custom property name using the --ghost- prefix, for example --ghost-action-primary-bg.

description.description: What the property controls. Do not list private --_ghost-* names.
